description: Class representing the header and footer of a specific page type (even or first) of a worksheet.

GetCenterFooter.description: Returns the center footer section of this page type.

GetCenterHeader.description: Returns the center header section of this page type.

GetLeftFooter.description: Returns the left footer section of this page type.

GetLeftHeader.description: Returns the left header section of this page type.

GetRightFooter.description: Returns the right footer section of this page type.

GetRightHeader.description: Returns the right header section of this page type.
